    "Reliable generation and storage of 2FA codes directly with logins.",

    "Affordable solution for a small business team."

  "cons": [
    "Initial setup of shared collections for a small team can be a bit clunky.",
    "Occasional need to re-authenticate or slow loading of the browser extension.",
    "Might encounter a slight learning curve for advanced sharing features."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Google Ads Specialist likely found Bitwarden to be a solid and affordable solution for securely managing numerous client accounts and performing two-factor authentication. The built-in TOTP functionality streamlined their workflow, keeping login credentials and 2FA codes together. While the initial organization of shared credentials for a small team might have required some effort, the daily use through the browser extension was generally efficient and reliable."
